title: Blameless postmortems and a culture of learning

videos.script: The first notes on the sixth of March said: root cause, logistics ran a backfill during peak without checking. Accurate, as far as it went. {{title}} The engineer who ran it had followed the runbook. Nothing told him Friday evening mattered. Any engineer, with that runbook, could have done the same. {{runbook}} That is the sentence a blameless review is looking for. Not who did it. Why it made sense to do it. {{timeline}} Then the holes that lined up that evening. Six of them, each harmless on its own. {{cheese}} Then actions with an owner, a date and a ticket, and a number the team checks every month. And the culture all of this is for: a team where bad news travels fast, because reporting it has never cost anybody anything.
